finding.claim: Agile-encrypted (OLE/CFB) input can panic the process during Decrypt instead of returning an error (DoS, no password needed). Attacker-controlled XML/base64 fields reach unchecked slice/index/cipher operations: keyEncryptor saltValue decoding to a length other than 16 bytes (cipher.NewCBCDecrypter panics), encryptedKeyValue not a multiple of 16 (CryptBlocks panics), missing <keyEncryptor> (index [0] at crypt.go:439 and 422), blockSize="0" (integer divide by zero at crypt.go:545), EncryptionInfo shorter than 8 bytes (crypt.go:413).
finding.source: Untrusted file bytes: OLE header and EncryptionInfo stream of any CFB input passed to OpenReader/OpenFile. Decrypt runs on every OLE input, whether or not a Password is set.
finding.sink: crypt.go:431 decrypt(key, saltValue, encryptedKeyValue) -> crypt.go:518 CBCDecrypter; crypt.go:545 modulo by encryptedKey.BlockSize; no recover() anywhere in the package.

trace.note: openReaderAt: OLE magic detected, Decrypt called with no password gate
Decrypt: maxStreamSize bounds stream allocation only
encryptionMechanism: only checks len>=4 before reading version
convertPasswdToKey: KeyEncryptor[0] index with no length check
decrypt with attacker-sized IV (salt) and ciphertext
NewCBCDecrypter / CryptBlocks panic on bad IV or length

finding.guards_checked: crypt.go:149-151 and 202 bound stream size only, not inner field lengths. crypt.go:222 requires len>=4 only. crypt.go:440 bounds spinCount, not the other fields. aes.NewCipher errors are handled, but the IV and input lengths are never validated. decrypt ignores its error at 431. No recover() in the package.

finding.claim: Standard-encrypted (OLE/CFB) input panics on truncated or malformed EncryptionInfo/EncryptedPackage streams (DoS, no password needed). Unchecked slicing: [8:12] at 244, [12:12+encryptionHeaderSize] at 245 (uint32 header size, can wrap), block[:4]..block[28:32] at 247-254 (needs len>=32), block[32:] at 255, encryptionInfoBuf[12+size:] at 257, verifier blob[:4], blob[36:40], blob[40:72] at crypt.go:290-299, and encryptedPackageBuf[8:] at 274 when the stream is missing or shorter than 8 bytes.
finding.source: Untrusted CFB file: EncryptionInfo and EncryptedPackage stream contents and their declared header sizes.
finding.sink: Slice-bounds and index operations in standardDecrypt and standardEncryptionVerifier.

trace.note: encryptionMechanism: len>=4 check, then version 2.2 selects standard
encryptionInfoBuf[12:12+encryptionHeaderSize]; uint32 header size can overflow and panic
encryptedPackageBuf[8:] with nil or short stream

finding.guards_checked: crypt.go:197-217 check entry.Size against maxStreamSize but not sub-structure lengths. encryptionMechanism checks len>=4 only. No recover() in the package.

finding.claim: SearchSheet compiles the search value as a regular expression on every call, even when regSearch is false, so a plain-text search containing regex metacharacters that do not compile (e.g. "(", "[", "*", "?") panics via regexp.MustCompile. Logic flaw with DoS impact when the application passes user-supplied search text.
finding.source: The value argument of SearchSheet (sheet.go:1098), which the caller may take from user input; the reg flag is false by default.
finding.sink: sheet.go:1133 regexp.MustCompile(value), executed before the regSearch branch at sheet.go:1157.

trace.note: SearchSheet(sheet, value, reg...): regSearch defaults to false
regSearch branch only consults the compiled regex after compilation has already panicked

finding.guards_checked: checkSheetName validates only the sheet name (sheet.go:1103). The sheet-exists check (1110) does not validate value. No recover() and no regexp.Compile error handling.

finding.claim: Form-control text is written into the VML drawing without XML escaping. FormControl.Text (line 608) and each Paragraph run's Text (line 612) go into vmlFont.Content, which is tagged `,innerxml`, so markup from the caller is emitted verbatim. Attacker text can break the VML part or inject extra elements and attributes into the output workbook (integrity impact; not script execution in Excel).
finding.source: FormControl.Text and FormControl.Paragraph[i].Text, supplied via AddFormControl. Untrusted if the application builds form text from user input.
finding.sink: vmlDrawing.go:150 vmlFont.Content with xml:",innerxml", serialized into xl/drawings/vmlDrawingN.vml via addFormCtrl.

trace.note:
raw run.Text + "

\r\n" concatenated; // wrappers are also raw
innerxml: no escaping at marshal time

finding.guards_checked: Font.Color gets a '#' prefix (vml.go:617-618) and Face/Color attributes are escaped by encoding/xml, but the Text content is not. Contrast with cell.go:545-563 trimCellValue, which escapes.

finding.claim: Zip bomb memory exhaustion. Non-worksheet zip entries are fully buffered in memory, and the buffer is preallocated to the declared size. The default UnzipSizeLimit is 16 GiB (templates.go:195), so a small upload can drive up to 16 GiB of RSS. Impact is DoS and is configuration-dependent.
finding.source: Attacker-supplied xlsx archive (zip entry declared sizes and compressed data).
finding.sink: lib.go:162 make([]byte, 0, declared size) and lib.go:164 io.Copy into bytes.Buffer, via readFile called from lib.go:86.

trace.note: only xl/worksheets/sheet* and sharedStrings above UnzipXMLSizeLimit go to temp files
all other entries call readFile fully into memory

finding.guards_checked: lib.go:33-41 and 55-60 cap the declared sizes and their sum at UnzipSizeLimit (16 GiB default, templates.go:195). Go archive/zip returns ErrFormat if decompressed bytes exceed the declared size, so declared-size lying does not bypass the cap. Temp-file streaming covers worksheets only. Per-entry size is not capped below the total.

finding.claim: AddPicture reads any filesystem path the caller supplies, with only a file-extension allowlist. If the application passes user-controlled paths, the bytes of any file whose name ends in an image extension are embedded in the returned workbook (arbitrary file read / exfiltration). Conditional on application misuse.
finding.source: The name argument of AddPicture, which is a filesystem path.
finding.sink: picture.go:205 os.ReadFile(filepath.Clean(name)), with contents embedded via AddPictureFromBytes.

trace.note: os.ReadFile(filepath.Clean(name)): no root confinement, no content sniffing

finding.guards_checked: Extension allowlist only (picture.go:201-204). No root confinement, no symlink check, no content validation. The bytes are not decoded before embedding, so arbitrary content passes.

finding.claim: Agile key derivation runs up to 1e7 hash iterations (maxSpinCount, crypt.go:51) before any password or verifier check. Each OpenReader call on a crafted file therefore costs roughly 10^7 hashes of CPU, with no authentication needed. Low-severity CPU DoS amplification.
finding.source: spinCount attribute of the attacker's agile EncryptedKey (crypt.go:99).

trace.note: spinCount bounded to 0..1e7, so 1e7 is allowed
1e7 hash iterations executed before any verification

finding.guards_checked: crypt.go:440 range check on spinCount (upper bound 1e7). No rate limit or caching. Legitimate Excel default is 100000, so the cap is 100x that.
